functions.name: community_signal_aggregates
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.community_signal_aggregates()
 RETURNS TABLE(area_label text, week_start date, report_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select coalesce(b.label,s.area_unit,'Manila city (area not specified)'),date_trunc('week',s.onset_date::timestamp)::date,count(*)
 from public.community_signals s left join public.manila_barangay_catalog b on b.code=s.barangay_code
 where s.withdrawn_at is null and s.moderation='approved' and s.created_at<=now()-interval '72 hours' and s.created_at>now()-interval '90 days'
 group by s.area_unit,s.barangay_code,b.label,date_trunc('week',s.onset_date::timestamp) having count(*)>=3;
$function$

functions.name: delete_community_report
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.delete_community_report(p_reference_code text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if p_reference_code is null or length(p_reference_code) > 64 then return; end if;
  update public.community_reports set deleted_at = current_timestamp,
    contact_opt_in = false, contact_value = null, barangay_text = null
  where reference_code = encode(sha256(convert_to(upper(btrim(p_reference_code)), 'UTF8')), 'hex')
    and deleted_at is null;
end; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reviewed_upload_series()
 RETURNS TABLE(upload_id uuid, citation text, city text, week_ending date, cases integer)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select u.id,u.citation,item->>'city',(item->>'week_ending')::date,(item->>'cases')::integer
 from public.surveillance_uploads u cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(u.rows) item where u.status='published';
$function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.staff_role()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select case when coalesce(nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims',true),'')::jsonb->>'aal','')<>'aal2' then null
 when exists(select 1 from private.admin_users where user_id=auth.uid()) then 'admin'
 else (select role from private.staff_roles where user_id=auth.uid()) end;
$function$

functions.name: staff_signal_queue
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.staff_signal_queue()
 RETURNS SETOF community_signals
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if coalesce(public.staff_role(),'') not in ('moderator','admin') then raise exception 'Staff access required' using errcode='42501';end if;
 insert into public.staff_audit(actor,action) values(auth.uid(),'view_signal_queue');
 return query select * from public.community_signals where withdrawn_at is null order by created_at desc limit 200;
end;$function$

functions.name: withdraw_signal
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.withdraw_signal(p_code text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if p_code is null or length(p_code)>64 then return;end if;
 update public.community_signals set withdrawn_at=now(),onset_date=null,duplicate_hash=null,note_text=null,symptoms='{}',barangay_code=null,area_unit=null,report_type=null,affected_range=null
 where code_hash=encode(sha256(convert_to(upper(btrim(p_code)),'UTF8')),'hex') and withdrawn_at is null;
end;$function$
